paragraphs: R' Shaya said, ‘Rav Ashi's view appears reasonable’: Zevahim 34b [the checked Bavli has Rav Shaya]. Yuhasin has R' Shehaya, Zevahim chapter 3; perhaps this was his reading, or it is a scribal error.
